No black contour outlining the whole figure. Reference 2 does not supply clothes, weapons, stance, hair or camera.
Finish at the actual 48x96 logical sprite density, shown as an integer enlargement. Avoid faux tiny pixels or a high-resolution painted portrait. One figure only, full head to shoes uncropped, no words, labels, watermark or additional props. REAL transparent alpha background.
